results.problem: Minimum-weight decoding / nearest codeword problem for homological cycle codes
results.bound: \text{NP-complete (decision); NP-hard (nearest-codeword) for every fixed } \mathbb{F}_q \text{ with } q>2
results.previous_best: Polynomial time for binary cycle codes
results.quote: For every fixed finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$ with $q>2$, the following decision problem is NP-complete. Given a homological cycle code with parity-check matrix $B^T$, a syndrome $\mathbf{s}$, and an integer $w\ge 0$, decide whether there exists $\mathbf{e}\in\mathbb{F}_q^m$ with $B^T\mathbf{e}=\mathbf{s}$ and $|\mathbf{e}|\le w$. Consequently, nearest-codeword decoding is NP-hard for these codes.

results.problem: ML whole-word decoding error probability for cycle codes on random regular graphs
results.quote: Fix $D\ge 3$, a finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$, an even replacement distribution $\theta$, and $0<p<1/2$. If $G_n$ is uniform among simple $D$-regular graphs on $n$ labeled vertices, then $\liminf_{n\rightarrow\infty}\mathbb{E}_{G_n}P_\mathrm{W}^\mathrm{ML}(G_n,p,\theta)\ge(p\theta_\mathrm{max})^3\left(1-\exp\left[-\frac{(D-1)^3}{6}\right]ight)>0,$

results.problem: ML decoding success probability on Linial-Simkin ensemble
results.quote: Fix $D\ge 3$, a finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$, $c\in(0,1)$, and an even replacement distribution $\theta$. For the Linial-Simkin ensemble and independent errors with distribution (58), $(D-1)Z_\theta(p)>1\Longrightarrow\mathbb{E}_G P_\mathrm{S}^\mathrm{ML}(G,p,\theta)\rightarrow 0,0<p\le 1/2.$ In particular, $\delta_\mathrm{rel}(D,\theta)\le\delta_\mathrm{cyc}(D,\theta)$.

results.problem: Reliability threshold \delta_\mathrm{rel} for cycle codes on Linial-Simkin ensemble
results.previous_best: Binary endpoint exact at every D\ge 3 [DZ97; NZ16]
results.quote: Fix $c\in(0,1)$ and an even replacement distribution $\theta$ on $\mathbb{F}_q^\times$. For the Linial-Simkin ensemble, if $\gamma=q/D^{2/3}\le 1/32$, then $(1-16\gamma)\delta_\mathrm{cyc}(D,\theta)\le\delta_\mathrm{rel}(D,\theta)\le\delta_\mathrm{cyc}(D,\theta).$

results.problem: LP decoding failure probability for cycle codes
results.quote: Let $G$ be a simple graph with $m$ edges, maximum degree at most $D\ge 3$, and girth $g_G$. Consider its homological cycle code over $\mathbb{F}_q$ with each position corrupted independently with probability $0<p<1/2$ and arbitrary nonzero error values. For every integer $1\le h<g_G$, the probability that the LP decoder declares failure or returns an incorrect word satisfies $P_\mathrm{W}^\mathrm{LP}(G,p)\le 2m(D-1)^{h-1}\left[2\sqrt{p(1-p)}\right]^h.$

Fix $D\ge 3$, a finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$, and $c\in(0,1)$. Define the certified rate $p_\mathrm{LP}^\mathrm{cert}(D,c):=\frac{1}{2}\left(1-\sqrt{1-(D-1)^{-2(1+1/c)}}\right)>0.$ For every fixed $0<p<p_\mathrm{LP}^\mathrm{cert}(D,c)$, there is a constant $\kappa>0$ such that $\sup_{G\in\mathrm{supp}\mathcal{L}_{n,D,c}}P_\mathrm{W}^\mathrm{LP}(G,p)=O_{D,c,p}(n^{-\kappa})\rightarrow 0.$

results.previous_best: Prior work showed DQI achieves nontrivial satisfaction fraction guarantee only on linear-girth graphs
results.quote: Fix $D\ge 3$, a finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$, and $c\in(0,1)$. Consider Max-2-LINSAT instances on the LS ensemble $G\sim\mathcal{L}_{n,D,c}$ (Definition 4) with target sets of common size $r$ such that the corresponding noise channels all have a shared error distribution $\theta$. Let $\rho=r/q$. ... Then $F_{D,\theta,r}^\mathrm{DQI}\le F_\rho(\min\{\delta_\mathrm{cyc}(D,\theta),1-\rho\}).$ (88) If $\gamma=q/D^{2/3}\le 1/32$, then also $F_{D,\theta,r}^\mathrm{DQI}\ge F_\rho(\min\{(1-16\gamma)\delta_\mathrm{cyc}(D,\theta),1-\rho\}).$ (89)

Consequently, for $q=o(D^{2/3})$, $F_{q,D}^\mathrm{DQI}=\frac{q-1}{q}\left(1+\frac{1}{D-1}\right)+o(D^{-1})$. For MaxCut, the exact binary threshold in (79) gives the exact reliable-decoding value $F_{2,D}^\mathrm{DQI}=\frac{1}{2}+\sqrt{\delta_\mathrm{cyc}(D,2)(1-\delta_\mathrm{cyc}(D,2))}=\frac{1}{2}+\frac{1}{2(D-1)}$.
